verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents its own recurring mechanism: recurring Pix payments collected after a one-time authorization. It also lets you schedule Pix and TED transfers, but that is a one-off future-dated action, not a recurring schedule. Support is therefore limited to one payment-specific recurring flow rather than general recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: general recurring job/workflow scheduling, documented cadence or interval configuration, recurring outbound transfers, schedule management (pause/edit/cancel), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Receive recurring payments through Pix after a one-time authorization
